regions.name: Atlantic Arc
regions.settlement_pattern: dense coastal megaregions and inland logistics corridors
regions.character: Old cities merged into layered freight and passenger corridors without losing local identities.

regions.name: Pacific Arc
regions.settlement_pattern: coastal megaregions and major interior production belts
regions.character: One of Earth's largest production and consumption zones.

regions.name: Interior Networks
regions.settlement_pattern: agricultural, industrial and metropolitan corridors
regions.character: Bulk freight feeds coastal and orbital export systems.

regions.name: Other Earth Regions
regions.settlement_pattern: diverse urban, rural and protected landscapes
regions.character: Aggregate record for Earth's many distinct regions not individually authored.

regions.name: Northern Corridor
regions.settlement_pattern: pressurized cities linked by rail and buried utilities
regions.character: Mature Martian urban belt.

regions.name: Equatorial Industry Belt
regions.settlement_pattern: industrial cities and launch complexes
regions.character: Surface-to-orbit industry dominates land use.

regions.name: Nearside Industrial Network
regions.settlement_pattern: excavated cities, terminals and buried factories
regions.character: Old infrastructure layered beneath newer freight works.

regions.name: Shelf Cities
regions.settlement_pattern: low broad coastal cities behind immense sea defenses
regions.character: The densest Kesh urban-industrial region.

regions.name: Upland Works
regions.settlement_pattern: industrial valleys and fortified transport corridors
regions.character: High-load infrastructure and extraction dominate.

regions.name: Escarpment Belt
regions.settlement_pattern: vertical cities and suspended transit
regions.character: Height is ordinary urban distance.

regions.name: Nine Currents Basin
regions.settlement_pattern: floating, island and submerged districts
regions.character: Waterways function as streets, utilities and industrial space.

regions.name: Deep Network
regions.settlement_pattern: interconnected subterranean cities
regions.character: The distinction between neighborhood and infrastructure is deliberately weak.

regions.name: Exchange Belt
regions.settlement_pattern: multispecies trade cities and intermodal corridors
regions.character: Known space's densest concentration of cross-species commerce.

regions.name: New Houston Industrial Region
regions.settlement_pattern: fabrication cities, rail freight and launch fields
regions.character: Independent yards shape the regional economy.

regions.name: Greenline Belt
regions.settlement_pattern: widely separated agricultural towns and processing hubs
regions.character: Harvest traffic dominates seasonal life.

regions.name: Keelward Industrial Region
regions.settlement_pattern: foundry cities feeding orbital yards
regions.character: Nearly every employer ultimately serves large-hull construction.

regions.name: Lowell Plateau
regions.settlement_pattern: research cities and instrument campuses
regions.character: Cargo handling is unusually specification-driven.

regions.name: Crosswater Chain
regions.settlement_pattern: island and floating urban chain
regions.character: Mixed Vey-human civic culture is strongest here.

regions.name: Deepworks Region
regions.settlement_pattern: subterranean factory-city network
regions.character: Surface terminals reveal little of the industrial volume below.

regions.name: Hopewell Claims District
regions.settlement_pattern: boomtown, camps and active claims
regions.character: Most of Talos's current growth is concentrated here.

regions.name: Beacon Region
regions.settlement_pattern: single town plus scattered survey and extraction sites
regions.character: The last concentrated civilian infrastructure before the outward corridor.
